title: Documentation site
confidence_notes: The deliverable is rendered documentation. Signals: a static-site generator config, a docs/ or content/ tree of markdown or rst, a build that emits HTML, an API reference generated from a package. If the docs live inside a code repo, this is secondary to the code archetype and its goals only make sense in a docs campaign. Readability scores are gameable and are shipped as diagnostics. API coverage is only meaningful when there is a package to document; the card assumes Python and interrogate, swap for typedoc or cargo doc warnings otherwise.

default_cards.title: Docs build exits nonzero

measure.command: if {{build_command}} >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo METRIC build_failed=0; else echo METRIC build_failed=1; fi

gaming_risks: strict mode disabled in the generator config so warnings no longer fail the build (a config operator; must be declared)
pages removed from the nav to make the build pass (nav_snapshot_diff_lines catches it)

default_cards.title: Broken internal links in the built site (lychee --offline)

measure.command: command -v lychee >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 3; {{build_command}} >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; lychee --offline --no-progress --format json --root-dir "$(pwd)/{{site_dir}}" '{{site_dir}}/**/*.html' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("METRIC broken_links=%d" % (d.get("failures",0)+d.get("errors",0)))'

gaming_risks: links removed instead of fixed (a page that links to nothing has zero broken links; the nav snapshot and a word-count diagnostic show the shrinkage)
an exclude pattern added to .lycheeignore (frozen) or inline via --exclude in a non-frozen wrapper

default_cards.title: Docstring coverage of {{package_dir}} (interrogate)
gaming_risks: one-word or template docstrings ("Docstring.") that satisfy the counter; the judge should read a sample of added docstrings
public symbols made private with a leading underscore to shrink the denominator
[tool.interrogate] exclude widened (the config lives in pyproject.toml, frozen for this card)

default_cards.title: Flesch reading ease over all pages (textstat)

measure.command: python3 -c 'import textstat' 2>/dev/null || exit 3; python3 -c 'import glob,re,textstat; t=" ".join(open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read() for f in glob.glob("{{docs_dir}}/**/*.md", recursive=True)); t=re.sub(r"```.*?```", " ", t, flags=re.S); print("METRIC readability_fre=%.2f" % textstat.flesch_reading_ease(t))'

degradation.apply: printf '\nNotwithstanding the aforementioned considerations, the implementation heretofore described necessitates comprehensive reconsideration of the architectural underpinnings, particularly insofar as the interdependencies between constituent subsystems manifest emergent characteristics.\n' >> {{any_doc_page}}

gaming_risks: this is the archetypal gameable metric: short sentences of short words score high regardless of meaning; it ships as a diagnostic and should not be a goal without a human reading the diff
technical terms removed or misspelled to lower syllable counts

default_cards.title: Docs build wall-clock

degradation.apply:
python3 -c "import os; d='{{docs_dir}}/sb_bloat'; os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True); [open(os.path.join(d, 'p%03d.md' % i), 'w').write('# Page %d

' % i + ('lorem ipsum dolor sit amet ' * 400 + '

') * 20) for i in range(150)]"

gaming_risks: plugins disabled (search index, minification, social cards) in the generator config outside a declared config hypothesis
an incremental build cache left in place (the command removes the site dir; a plugin cache elsewhere is the workaround)

default_cards.title: Lines differing between the built nav links and the frozen snapshot

measure.command: {{build_command}} >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; [ -f {{nav_snapshot}} ] || exit 3; n=$(grep -o 'href="[^"#?]*"' {{site_dir}}/index.html | sed 's/href=//; s/"//g' | grep -v '^http' | LC_ALL=C sort -u | diff - {{nav_snapshot}} | grep -c '^[<>]'); echo "METRIC nav_snapshot_diff_lines=$n"

gaming_risks: nav entries kept while the pages behind them were emptied (broken_links stays zero for an empty page; a per-page word-count floor is the stronger instrument if this matters)

noise_sources: none significant for counts; build time varies with disk cache and any search-index plugin
notes: Fill {{build_command}} from the generator (mkdocs build --strict, sphinx-build -W -b html docs site, npm run build, mdbook build), {{site_dir}} with its output (site, _build/html, build, book), {{docs_dir}} with the source tree, {{nav_source_file}} with the file that defines navigation (mkdocs.yml nav, SUMMARY.md, sidebars.js), and {{nav_snapshot}} with a checked-in sorted list of nav hrefs created at INSTRUMENT and frozen. The docs operator is the warm one; bugfix means fixing a wrong statement or a broken example, which is the most valuable docs change and the one a link counter cannot see. broken_links and api_doc_coverage are the usable goals; readability ships as a diagnostic on purpose. lychee's JSON summary keys (failures, errors) are those of lychee 0.14+; verify once with a known-broken link before trusting the card.
